question: List the names and email addresses of the policyholders on claims handled by Campbell Body Works since March 2026.

input.sql: select repair_shop_id,name,state,metro from repair_shops where name ilike '%Campbell%'

sql: select repair_shop_id,name,state,metro from repair_shops where name ilike '%Campbell%'

input.sql: select ph.policyholder_id, ph.full_name, ph.email, count(*) as claims, min(c.report_date) first_report, min(c.loss_date) first_loss from claims c join policies p using(policy_id) join policyholders ph on ph.policyholder_id=p.policyholder_id where c.repair_shop_id='RS-041' and c.report_date>=DATE '2026-03-01' group by all order by ph.full_name

report.interpretation: Policyholders with at least one claim at Campbell Body Works (repair shop RS-041, Chicago, IL) that was reported on or after 2026-03-01, up to the extract date of 2026-09-30. I read "since March 2026" as report date. Repair shops are only recorded on auto collision, glass and hail claims. Each policyholder is listed once. You are the fraud team lead, so names and emails are shown.
report.answer: 42 policyholders have claims at Campbell Body Works reported since 1 March 2026. Each has exactly one claim. The names and emails are in the answer_sql result. They include Alexandra Collins (alexandra.collins89@example.com), Alexis Thompson (alexis.thompson901@example.com) and Alyssa Erickson (alyssa.erickson455@example.com). Two claims were reported in March but had loss dates in February (Alexis Thompson, Isabella Flores). If you meant loss date instead of report date, those two would drop out. Claims reported in the last few weeks may be incomplete because of late reporting.
report.answer_sql: select ph.full_name, ph.email from claims c join policies p using(policy_id) join policyholders ph on ph.policyholder_id=p.policyholder_id where c.repair_shop_id='RS-041' and c.report_date>=DATE '2026-03-01' group by all order by ph.full_name

findings.claim: 42 distinct policyholders, one claim each, on Campbell Body Works (RS-041) claims reported 2026-03-01 to 2026-09-30.
